# katapult_certificates (Data Source)

Lists every certificate in the organization. The list endpoint returns summary fields only; use the `katapult_certificate` data source for full details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every certificate in the organization
data "katapult_certificates" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) Certificates in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `expires_at` (String) When the certificate expires, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Null until issued.
- `id` (String) The ID of the certificate.
- `issuer` (String) The certificate issuer: `lets_encrypt`, `custom`, or `self_signed`.
- `last_issued_at` (String) When the certificate was last issued, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Null until issued.
- `name` (String) The primary hostname.
- `state` (String) The certificate state: `pending`, `issuing`, `issued`, or `issue_failed`.
